name: VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Teens do 60 hours of training, then give 40 hours of service at the museum. Thinkery says 208 VolunTeens served 8,880 hours in its last reported year.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 18. Other rules are not stated on the page I could read.
pay_detail: Volunteer service. Cost and pay are not stated on the page I could read.
duration: 60 hours of training plus 40 hours of service
deadline_text: Dates and application window are not stated on the page I could read.
how_to_apply: Thinkery's VolunTeens web address forwards to an online volunteer application (Volgistics). That form needs JavaScript, so I could not read it. Check it for the current steps.
notes: Thinkery also runs a teen Counselor in Training program for summer camps. Its page was not found (404), so it is not listed here. Check the dates, cost and application window before you apply.
